cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(HardwareUI VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(hardwareui INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(hardwareui INTERFACE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(hardwareui INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
add_library(hardwareui_juce INTERFACE)
target_link_libraries(hardwareui_juce INTERFACE hardwareui juce::juce_gui_basics)
target_include_directories(hardwareui_juce INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/adapters/juce)
option(HARDWAREUI_BUILD_TESTS "Build dependency-free core checks" OFF)
if(HARDWAREUI_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(hardwareui_tests tests/core.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(hardwareui_tests PRIVATE hardwareui)
  add_test(NAME hardwareui_core COMMAND hardwareui_tests)
endif()
